body.detail: Invoice inv-fa3cc401 must pass the 3-way match before approval.

evidence.expected: Business rules (three_way_match_gate) and Invoices: HTTP 400 with rule three_way_match_gate when approving an invoice that has not passed the 3-way match.
evidence.reason: Approve on invoice inv-fa3cc401, which was created and never matched, returned 400 with rule three_way_match_gate.

body.detail: Cannot receive 12 of LUM-2X4-8: ordered 5, already received 0.

evidence.expected: Business rules (receive_quantity_limit) and Purchase orders: HTTP 400 with rule receive_quantity_limit when the received quantity exceeds the ordered quantity.
evidence.reason: Receiving 12 of LUM-2X4-8 on a line ordered for 5 returned 400 with rule receive_quantity_limit.

evidence.expected: Business rules (overpayment_protection) and Invoices: HTTP 400 with rule overpayment_protection when the invoice is one cent over the received value. There is no tolerance.
evidence.reason: The purchase order line was quantity 1 at unit_price 4.75 and was fully received (received_value 4.75). The invoice for quantity 1 at 4.76 was created with HTTP 201 and total_amount 4.76, one cent over the received value.

body.detail: Vendor vnd-cde84750 is inactive. Purchase orders need an active vendor.

evidence.expected: Business rules (inactive_vendor_gate) and Purchase orders: HTTP 400 with rule inactive_vendor_gate when creating a purchase order for an inactive vendor.
evidence.reason: A purchase order for vendor vnd-cde84750, created in this attack with active false, returned 400 with rule inactive_vendor_gate.

body.detail: line_items.0.quantity: quantity must be greater than 0

evidence.expected: Purchase orders and Errors: quantity must be greater than 0, so HTTP 400 with rule validation_error.
evidence.reason: A purchase order line with quantity 0 returned 400 with rule validation_error.

evidence.expected: Business rules (duplicate_invoice_detection): HTTP 400 with rule duplicate_invoice_detection. INV-7 and inv-7 are the same invoice number.
evidence.reason: On one vendor, invoice number INV-7 was accepted (201) and inv-7 was then also accepted (201). The documented comparison ignores case, so the second invoice should have been rejected. A second breach on this rule: INV-7 was accepted and the same number with a leading and trailing space was also accepted (201) and stored as ' INV-7 ', which the documented comparison treats as the same number.

evidence.expected: Business rules (partial_receipt_flag) and Invoices: the match result sets partial_receipt to true when any purchase-order line is not fully received, including a shortfall on the last line.
evidence.reason: LUM-2X4-8 was received 4 of 4 and PLY-12-4X8 was received 3 of 10, so fully_received is false. The match returned 200 with partial_receipt false, received_value 86.2 and ordered_value 243. The flag should be true.

evidence.expected: Business rules (gl_balance) and Invoices: approval posts a balanced ledger entry where total debits equal total credits.
evidence.reason: Approval of lines priced 0.1 and 0.2 returned 200. The ledger debit is 0.3, the credit is 0.3, balanced is true, and that matches invoice total_amount 0.3.

body.detail: Goods can only be received on a submitted purchase order. po-ce6b1306 is draft.

evidence.expected: Business rules (workflow_gate) and Purchase orders: receive only on a submitted purchase order, so HTTP 400 with rule workflow_gate.
evidence.reason: Receiving against a draft purchase order returned 400 with rule workflow_gate.

evidence.expected: Business rules (duplicate_approval) and Invoices: an invoice can be approved only once, so HTTP 400 with rule duplicate_approval.
evidence.reason: The second approve on an already approved invoice returned 400 with rule duplicate_approval.

body.detail: SKU PLY-12-4X8 is not on the purchase order.

evidence.expected: Business rules (invoice_line_validation) and Invoices: every invoice line is for a SKU on the purchase order, so HTTP 400 with rule invoice_line_validation.
evidence.reason: An invoice for PLY-12-4X8 against a purchase order that contains only LUM-2X4-8 returned 400 with rule invoice_line_validation.

evidence.expected: Business rules (vendor_exposure_math) and Vendors: a vendor's exposure equals the sum of total_amount over that vendor's approved invoices.
evidence.reason: The vendor had one approved invoice with total_amount 9.5. GET exposure returned open_ap_liability 9.5 for that invoice, and the approval returned vendor_exposure 9.5.

summary: Nine of the twelve tested rules held. Three broke, and each break was confirmed on a new vendor and a new order. overpayment_protection accepted an invoice of 4.76 after goods worth 4.75 were received, so 0.01 was billed with no tolerance allowed. duplicate_invoice_detection accepted a second invoice of 4.75 when the number differed only by case, and another second invoice of 4.75 when the number differed only by surrounding spaces. partial_receipt_flag returned false while the last line was short, so a receipt of 86.20 against an order of 243.00 was treated as complete and 156.80 still outstanding was not flagged. No attack was undocumented.
